INSERT INTO D360.test_target_table1_between_busc
select * 
FROM 
 (SELECT 1 id, 'a' name, '2023-01-01' validstartdate, '2023-01-02' validenddate
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 id, 'b' name, '2023-01-01' validstartdate, '2023-01-03' validenddate
UNION ALL
SELECT 3 id, 'c' name, '2023-01-01' validstartdate, '2023-01-03' validenddate
UNION ALL
SELECT 4 id, 'd' name, '2023-01-01' validstartdate, '2023-01-03' validenddate
UNION ALL
SELECT 5 id, 'e' name, '2023-01-01' validstartdate, '' validenddate
UNION ALL
SELECT 6 id, 'f' name, '2023-01-03' validstartdate, '2023-01-03' validenddate) a


 
SELECT *  INTO D360.test_target_table1_between_busc from (
SELECT 1 id, 'aaa' name, '2023-01-03' validstartdate, '2023-01-03' validenddate
UNION ALL
SELECT 1 id, 'aa' name, '2023-01-04' validstartdate, '' validenddate
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 id, 'bb' name, '2023-01-04' validstartdate, '' validenddate
UNION ALL
SELECT 4 id, 'cc' name, '2023-01-04' validstartdate, '' validenddate
UNION ALL
SELECT 5 id, 'dd' name, '2023-01-04' validstartdate, '' validenddate
UNION ALL
SELECT 6 id, 'ff' name, '2023-01-04' validstartdate, '' validenddate) a




select * from D360.test_target_table1_between_busc

with src as (
SELECT 1 id2, 'aa' name2, '2023-01-02' processdate
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 id2, 'b' name2, '2023-01-02' processdate 
UNION ALL
SELECT 3 id2, 'c' name2, '2023-01-02' processdate
UNION ALL
SELECT 4 id2, 'd' name2, '2023-01-02' processdate
UNION ALL
SELECT 5 id2, 'e' name2, '2023-01-02' processdate
UNION ALL
SELECT 6 id2, 'f' name2, '2023-01-02' processdate  

)

, temp1 as (
    select * from D360.test_target_table1_between_busc tgt
    inner join src on tgt.id=src.id2 and src.processdate between tgt.validstartdate and tgt.validenddate 
)

select * from D360.test_target_table1_between_busc  tgt where exists (select 1 from  src where tgt.id=src.id2 and src.processdate between tgt.validstartdate and tgt.validenddate )

SELECT * FROM D360.test_target_table1_between_busc ORDER BY 1,3,4
